svg.title: A cocycle split becomes an extended-log-norm subadditivity statement
svg.desc: An early cocycle block beginning at the initial environment and a later block beginning at the shifted environment combine with the later block acting second. The full matrix value passes to the maximum absolute row-sum norm, whose product upper bound passes through a zero-aware extended logarithm and becomes an additive upper bound. A lower branch separates nonempty coordinates, where the time-zero norm is one and log value zero, from empty coordinates, where every norm is zero and every log value is bottom. A footer states that no integrability or limiting exponent is supplied.
svg.text: Turn the finite cocycle split into a zero-safe additive growth budget
The shift controls where the later block begins; the norm and extended logarithm control how its size combines.
EARLY COCYCLE BLOCK
begins at the initial environment and acts first
written on the right in the matrix product
SHIFTED LATER COCYCLE BLOCK
begins where the early base orbit ends and acts second
written on the left in the matrix product
FULL FINITE MATRIX VALUE
later block after early block, with no commutativity assumption
MAXIMUM ABSOLUTE ROW-SUM NORM
the full norm is at most the product of block norms
finite row sums also expose measurability
ZERO-AWARE EXTENDED LOGARITHM
the product budget becomes an additive budget
an exact zero matrix maps to bottom
NONEMPTY MATRIX COORDINATES
time-zero identity norm is one
time-zero extended log value is zero
EMPTY MATRIX COORDINATES
every finite matrix norm is zero
every extended log value is bottom
Finite-time only: no probability normalization, integrability, normalized growth, limiting exponent, or invariant splitting is supplied.
